states.title: A strange room
states.description: You enter the room. It's dark and damp, and the air is heavy. The stone walls are smooth and gritty, and the floor is covered in fine dust. Something tells you that this is a puzzle room, but you don't know what it is, nor how you got here.

req-desciptions.description: You've solved this puzzle already, theres no point in coming back here.

states.title: A Hint?
states.description: As you explore the room, you almost trip over something. When you bend down to look, you find a pedestal with words on it. You can't make out the words, but they seem to be related to the puzzle. Maybe they can help you solve the puzzle?

options.action: Ignore the pedestal and just start the puzzle

states.title: Reading the Hint
states.description:
You peer closely at the pedestal, and you can make out some words. It says something like "Ev_cIid's Flcm_nts " and shows the figure of some strange man. By the style and the appearance, you guess that he's Greek. 
 You're certain the words must be related to the puzzle, but you can't quite figure out what they mean. Maybe you could read it more closely? You should probably act quickly though, because it seems like the walls are shifting.

options.action: Give up reading and just start the puzzle

states.title: Starting the Puzzle
states.description: You look at the switches on the wall. There are sixteen of them arranged in order. They're even neatly labeled. You take a deep breath and hope for the best.

states.title: Starting the Puzzle
states.description: You look at the switches on the wall. There are sixteen of them arranged in order. They're even neatly labeled. Remembering the words on the pedestal, you take a deep breath and hope for the best.

states.title: You did it!
states.description: After toggling the sixteen switches, you find yourself back in the room. You can't remember how you got here, but you know you must have done it. Somehow.

states.title: Failed
states.description: As you move, the stone slams shut, plunging you into absolute darkness. You hear a sound like sand falling, and realize the walls are shifting. Without a way out, you are trapped. You never wake up, a forgotten casualty of the dark.

states.title: Switch [#]
states.description: You move to switch number [#]. The question is, do you toggle it, or move on to the next one?
